senses.gloss: (b. h.; v. preced.) [to be hot,] to ferment, be sour. Ad. Zar. 68ᵇ מי גרם לה שתֶּחְמַץ וכ׳ what was the cause that it (the dough) became leavened (rose) in one hour?

to cause leavening. Ib.ᵃ ראויה לחַמֵּץ וכ׳ Ms. M. (ed. לחַמֵּעַ) fit to leaven with it many other doughs. Ib. וחִימְּצוּ; Orl. II, 11 נצטרפו וחִמְּצוּ (Y. ed. הצטרפו וחִימֵּיצוּ) and the two combined produced the required leavening, Ib. 9 וחִמְּצָהּ (Y. ed. וחִימֵּיצָהּ; Ab. Zar. l. c. והֶחְמִיצָהּ) and it made the dough rise.
units: Orl. II 6 כל המְחַמֵּץ whatever is used for producing fermentation; a. fr.—Trnsf. to mature, to continue a case over night, to reserve judgment.

<cite ref="Sanhedrin 35a:6">Snh. 35ᵃ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Isaiah 1:17">Is. I, 17</cite>, v. <cite ref="H01211">preced.</cite>) <he>אשרו דיין שמְחַמֵּץ את וכ׳</he> Ms. K. (ed. <he>אשרי</he>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 20) praise the judge (in capital cases) who reserves his judgment (over night); <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 257">Yalk. Is. 257</cite>.
<cite ref="Pesachim 40a:2">Pes. 40ᵃ</cite> <he>מי פירות אינן מַחְמִיצִין</he> juice of fruits produces no leavening (in the ritual sense).

Ab. Zar. 68ᵃ כדי להחמיץ (Orl. II, 8 לחַמֵּץ) enough to leaven the dough. Mekh. Bo s. 10 שאור שהוא מַחְמִיץ לאחרים leaven which is used for leavening other doughs; a. fr.—Trnsf. to procrastinate. Ib. s. 9 (play on המַצּוֹת, Ex. XII, 17) כדרך … אין מַחְמִיצִין את המִצְוָה as well as you must not allow the matsah to become sour, so you must not allow the mitsvah (religious act) to become sour by postponement; Yalk. Ex. 201.
<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 68b:6">Ab. Zar. 68ᵇ</cite> <he>ראויה להַחְמִיץ וכ׳</he> (Ms. M. <he>לחמע</he>) is likely to ferment in two hours.
Nidd. IX, 7 מי רגלים שהֶחְמִיצוּ urin which ferments.—Trnsf. to degenerate, become wicked.
<cite ref="Rosh Hashanah 3b:11">R. Hash. 3ᵇ</cite> <he>קודם שה׳</he> before he (the Persian King) changed for the worse.
<cite ref="Pesachim 28b:13">Pes. 28ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Pesachim 43a:18">43ᵃ</cite> <he>נ׳ מאליו</he> became sour of itself (not through a leavening means).
